title: MT-ViT-CCHA: Multi-Task Learning for Canine Cardiomegaly Classification and VHS Keypoint Detection

contributions.purpose: 自动化犬心脏肥大评估,同时输出关键点、分类与 VHS 分数
contributions.mechanism: MT-ViT-CCHA:预训练 ViT 主干 + HRNet 关键点头 + 分类头 + VHS 回归头,三任务端到端多任务学习
contributions.evaluation: 测试集平均分类准确率 81.8%(SD 1.38%,5 seeds),优于标准 ViT 77.5%
contributions.domain: 兽医心脏病学/医学影像
contributions.source_quote: the development of MT-ViT-CCHA that simultaneously performs keypoint detection for VHS calculation, heart size classification, and direct VHS regression

contributions.purpose: 增强三任务间信息流动
contributions.mechanism: 引入 cross-attention 融合 CLS 全局特征与局部 patch 特征
contributions.evaluation: 去掉 cross-attention 测试准确率从 81.8% 降至 76.5%
contributions.source_quote: We incorporate a cross-attention mechanism to enhance information flow between these tasks, leading to a more robust and accurate MT-ViT-CCHA

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的犬胸片数据集与流程
contributions.mechanism: 采用 DogHeart 数据集(约 2000 张,含 6 关键点+VHS+类别标注),详述预处理与使用
contributions.evaluation: 数据集划分 1400/200/400;承诺发表后开源代码与模型权重
contributions.source_quote: we utilize a comprehensive canine thoracic X-ray dataset, detailing our methodology for its preprocessing and usage

self_declared_provenance.quote: We primarily utilize an HRNet-inspired design, involving two transposed convolutional layers followed by a 1x1 convolution to produce the final heatmaps.

When learnable loss weighting is enabled, the total loss is dynamically adjusted using a method inspired by Kendall et al. (2018), where each task's loss is weighted by an inverse homoscedastic uncertainty

Our proposed MT-ViT-CCHA adopts an MTL strategy, integrating keypoint detection, classification, and regression, and utilizes a cross-attention mechanism to facilitate information sharing between these tasks, drawing inspiration from such advancements.

notes: 标准实证方法类论文,四元组适配良好。含消融负结果/trade-off:多任务消融中单任务 Classification Only 仅 72.5%,而 Keypoint+VHS 仅 43.3%,说明任务组合影响大;固定等权损失仅 74.8%,需可学习权重;DogHeart 数据集为他人(Li & Zhang 2024)所建,本文属复用+改进而非新建数据。作者自承 CONVT(85.3%)、RVT(87.3%)等对比模型准确率更高,本文未超 SOTA,仅称在性能与效率间平衡。
